Adobe Security Bulletin

Last updated on Sep 7, 2026

Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146

Summary

Adobe has released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. This update resolves a critical vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution.

Adobe is aware of CVE-2026-75650 being exploited in the wild.
